viz.indexWholeNumber: The index must be a whole number, like 3 or -1.
viz.walkingForward: Walking forward… {steps} steps from the start.
viz.walkingForwardOne: Walking forward… 1 step from the start.
viz.ranOut: Ran out of boxes. {index} is outside the valid range.
viz.twoAddressesBefore: This box has two addresses: index
viz.indexErrorTitle: IndexError: string index out of range
viz.sliceWholeNumbers: Start, stop and step must be whole numbers (or left blank for the default).
viz.collectedNone: No characters collected, the slice never moves from start towards stop.
viz.sliceEmpty: An empty slice is not an error, and slicing is forgiving where indexing is strict.
viz.sliceNegativeStep: A negative step walks the string from back to front. With blanks, start defaults to the last character and stop to just before the first.
viz.sliceDefault: Start is included, stop is excluded, and step controls how far each hop moves.
viz.valueErrorTitle: ValueError: slice step cannot be zero
viz.sliceIdleBefore: Leave boxes blank to use Python's defaults. Try step
viz.indexIdleAfter: or something out of range to see what happens.

visualiser.title: String Visualiser
visualiser.subtitle: Understand how Python strings work, including loops, conditions, and methods.
visualiser.descForLoop: for c in text:  iteration {n} of {total}  →  c = "{ch}"
visualiser.descWhileTrue: while {cond}:  i={i}  →  condition = True, visiting text[{i}] = "{ch}"
visualiser.descWhileFalse: while {cond}:  i={i}  →  condition = False, loop ends
visualiser.whileConditionUnrecognised: "{cond}" is not a condition this visualiser understands. Try a form like "i < 5".
visualiser.narrationIndexError: Index {index} is out of range for this string, so Python raises an IndexError.
visualiser.indexNotANumber: "{index}" is not a whole number — a Python index has to be an integer.
visualiser.indexOutOfRange: IndexError: string index out of range (valid indices: {min} to {max})
visualiser.sliceZeroStep: ValueError: slice step cannot be zero
visualiser.sliceInvalid: "{slice}" is not a valid slice — each part of start:stop:step must be a whole number or left blank.
visualiser.methodUnsupported: '{method}' is not one of the methods this visualiser supports. Try upper, lower, strip, title, reverse or len.
visualiser.couldNotEvaluateDetail: Could not evaluate "{expr}" — check the expression for a typo or an unsupported operator.
visualiser.hintWhileLoop: e.g. i < 5  (i starts at 0, increments by 1)
